name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the Singapore Grand Prix, fueling a drive for order and efficiency that found its perfect outlet in logistics. Before joining Tolman Motorsport, he honed his skills managing supply chains for a major electronics manufacturer, bringing a level of precision and problem-solving rarely seen in the paddock. Wei believes that flawless logistics are the unsung heroes of any successful racing team, meticulously planning every detail to ensure that the right equipment is always in the right place at the right time.

Known for his high standards and unwavering commitment, Wei's demanding nature stems from his belief that excellence is non-negotiable. He constantly seeks innovative solutions to streamline operations, optimizing everything from transport schedules to inventory management. His colleagues know him as a perfectionist who holds himself and others to the highest standards, always pushing the team towards peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down notes and observations.
Insists on color-coding all logistical charts and documents.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
